Export Volumes and Segmentations in nnU-Net v2 Format

Source: R/export-dataset.R
export_nnunet.Rd

Writes a cohort of dicom_volume and dicom_seg objects into an nnU-Net v2 directory tree (Dataset<id>_<name>/imagesTr, labelsTr, and dataset.json).

Usage

export_nnunet(
  volumes,
  segmentations,
  out_dir,
  dataset_name,
  dataset_id = 101L,
  channel_names = list(`0` = "CT"),
  file_ending = ".nii.gz"
)

Arguments

volumes

Named list of dicom_volume objects.

segmentations

Named list of dicom_seg objects matching volumes.

out_dir

Root output directory where the nnU-Net dataset folder will be created.

dataset_name

Short dataset name (alphanumeric/underscores).

dataset_id

Integer dataset ID (e.g., 101L).

channel_names

Named list mapping zero-indexed channel strings to modality names (default list("0" = "CT")).

file_ending

NIfTI file extension (".nii.gz" or ".nii").

Value

Invisibly returns a list with dataset_dir, dataset_json, images_dir, and labels_dir.
